title: Zak North Shared A Captivating Single Track, "The Drugs"
htmlContent:
Zak North's latest track, "The Drugs," is a captivating and soulful song that showcases his unique style and talent for blending different genres. With its contemporary R&B beats and moody vibe, the song is a must-listen for anyone who loves music that is both sexy and introspective.

Zak North is quickly rising out of the Queen City of Charlotte, NC, and has opted to conceal his identity with a marketing genius idea - a mask. Despite this unconventional approach, Zak's penmanship is second to none, and fans are taking notice.

"The Drugs" is a perfect example of Zak's talent for creating music that is both happy and thought-provoking. The song is an excellent addition to any contemporary R&B playlist with its catchy chorus and relatable lyrics.

Overall, Zak North is a rising star in the music industry, and "The Drugs" is a testament to his talent and creativity. We can't wait to see what he has for us next.
